estimand: Descriptive valid-completion and normalized Pareto quality by problem class and size; paired comparisons on fully observed instances
unit_and_frequency: Instance x method x seed; one fixed snapshot, no time-series frequency
predictors_and_controls: Method is the contrast; identical instance, seed and evaluation budget are comparison controls; size and class are moderators.
measurement: Executable definitions and fixed values in the linked protocol; independently validate exported schedules and objective values.
data_and_release_timing: Public deterministic scheduling collections acquired before execution; raw bytes and hashes frozen in each run.
timing_and_information_set: All instance data known at time zero. Earlier pilot results are known; no expanded results inspected before fixing the protocol.
primary_model: No fitted statistical model; medians over seeds followed by equal-instance descriptive averages.
benchmark_or_counterfactual: Eight APEX configurations and four pymoo implementations; no causal counterfactual.
expected_sign_or_contrast: No directional superiority prediction; characterize quality and completion across sizes.
inference: Descriptive only; three seeds, no p-values, no independent confirmation.
sample_and_exclusions: All legacy cases, all distributed Brandimarte cases, two hash-ranked identifiers per Taillard and Behnke-Geiger size block; full inclusion ledger; no outcome-based drops.
selection_tuning_evaluation_split: No tuning in this run. Prior development informed the implementation. Fixed expanded selection before execution.
preprocessing_scope: Parsing and index normalization only; source processing times unchanged; historical bounds are metadata.
complexity_budget: 1000 candidate evaluations, 3 seeds, 12 methods, 8 concurrent single-worker runs, common 240-second process watchdog.
pre_specified_robustness: Report by class, operation band, exact instance and legacy/extension cohort; no adaptive new variants.
episode_or_unit_stress_tests: Full published size-block coverage in the declared candidate collections.
diagnostics: Coverage, errors/timeouts, actual evaluations, source hashes, operation coverage, eligibility, durations, precedence, machine overlap, PFSP permutation, MS/FT recomputation.
non_supporting_pattern: Invalid archives, missing matrix cells, selective completion or gains confined to chosen sizes preclude broad claims.
allowed_interpretation: Descriptive performance of the frozen implementations on the specified subsets and budgets, with parallel-host contention.
